scope: Inventory only; existing SQLite compatibility code is unchanged by the raw journal migration.

items.behavior: Recognizes old UNIQUE(session_id,turn_id), renames the table, copies authoritative accounting rows, drops the old table.
Adds missing attribution_json and usage_json with inferred defaults.
Adds missing projected_sequence and turn_count; old turn counts use -1 sentinel.
Loads journal event vectors to backfill old negative turn counts while opening the index.
Read-only list/search/get paths tolerate old schemas by substituting zero for missing turn_count.

next_contract: Admit the current schema explicitly. Reject unsupported accounting state without deleting or silently replacing rows. Rebuild derived listing/search projections only through an explicit authority-preserving procedure; do not retain migration adapters.
raw_journal_contract: No compatibility reader or migration remains. Any events.jsonl entry is explicitly rejected before creating journal/. Existing old data is not mutated.
